content: {"question":"Is professional development paid by the employer in Germany taxable?","answer":"No, it is tax free.","evidence":"According to [section 1.2 of this article](https://www.haufe.de/personal/haufe-personal-office-platin/auswirkungen-einer-fortbildung-auf-die-entgeltabrechnung-lohnsteuer_idesk_PI42323_HI1562605.html) professional developement (Weiterbildung) paid by the employer is tax free."}
